experiment: Exp8E cross-task/seed/refresh robustness for Dream block-residual caching

prompts.factual_qa: What is the capital of Australia?
prompts.reasoning: What is 15 multiplied by 12? Explain briefly.
prompts.instruction: Explain in three short sentences why regular backups are important.

benchmark: Synchronized B-C-B baseline/cache/baseline full generation per trial; paired baseline=(before+after)/2; saving=1-cached/paired_baseline. Baseline token trajectories must match within pair for aggregate summaries.
cache_method: Each patched Dream block stores FP32 residual output-input at refresh calls. At reuse, original block.forward is bypassed and current_input + cached_residual returned; all selected blocks use the same periodic k. Caches reset each generation.
limitations: One model, single GPU; generated token trajectories evaluated, not probability/logit equivalence; no edge-cloud network; tested tasks/seeds only; latency includes generation + instrumentation and excludes report generation; no proof of quality preservation beyond tested trajectories.
